Run:  python3 song_demo.py            (prints the full song sheet)
      python3 song_demo.py midi       (writes song.mid, pure-python MIDI)

import json, struct, sys

SONG = {'title': 'Kiss Me, Dear Mother', 'artist': 'Stephen Foster (1857)', 'bpm': 84, 'time': '4/4', 'song_key': 'F major', 'structure': ['Verse 1', 'Verse 2'], 'chords': {'Verse 1': 'F - Bb - F - C', 'Verse 2': 'F - Bb - F - C'}, 'lyrics': {'Verse 1': 'Kiss me, dear mother, ere I go to sleep\nKiss me, dear mother, while the stars their vigils keep\nKiss me, dear mother, for the night is nigh\nKiss me, dear mother, lest I wake and cry', 'Verse 2': "Kiss me, dear mother, for to-morrow's sun\nMay never rise for me, my race may then be run\nKiss me, dear mother, while I breathe this prayer\nKiss me, dear mother, for thy love is rare"}, 'arrangement': "A son's farewell; parlor-song tenderness."}

CHORD_TONES = {"C":[0,4,7],"D":[2,6,9],"E":[4,8,11],"F":[5,9,0],"G":[7,11,2],
 "A":[9,1,4],"B":[11,3,6],"Em":[4,7,11],"Am":[9,0,4],"Dm":[2,5,9],"Bm":[11,2,6],
 "F#m":[6,9,1],"C#m":[1,4,8],"G#":[8,0,3],"Bb":[10,2,5],"Eb":[3,7,10]}

def parse_chord(sym):
    sym = sym.strip().replace("maj","").replace("min","m")
    base = sym[:2] if len(sym) > 1 and sym[1] in "#b" else sym[:1]
    minor = sym[len(base):].startswith("m")
    key = base + ("m" if minor else "")
    return CHORD_TONES.get(key, CHORD_TONES["C"]), base

def print_sheet():
    s = SONG
    print("=" * 60)
    print(s["title"].upper())
    print(s["artist"], "|", s["bpm"], "BPM", "|", s["time"], "| Key:", s["song_key"])
    print("=" * 60)
    for sec in s["structure"]:
        print("\n[" + sec.upper() + "]   (" + s["chords"].get(sec, "") + ")")
        for line in s["lyrics"].get(sec, "").split("\n"):
            if line.strip():
                print("  " + line)
    print("\n--- arrangement ---\n" + s["arrangement"])

def write_midi(path="song.mid", bars_per_chord=1):
    # Minimal SMF writer: one track, chord stabs on each bar, melody-ish bass.
    tick = 480
    events = []
    t = 0
    beat = tick
    for sec in SONG["structure"]:
        for sym in SONG["chords"].get(sec, "C").split("-"):
            tones, _ = parse_chord(sym)
            for tone in tones:
                note = 60 + tone
                events.append((t, 0x90, note, 90))
                events.append((t + beat * 4 * bars_per_chord, 0x80, note, 0))
            t += beat * 4 * bars_per_chord
    events.sort()
    track = b"\x00\xff\x03\x0b" + SONG["title"][:11].encode() + b""
    track = b"\x00\xff\x51\x03" + struct.pack(">I", int(60000000 // SONG["bpm"]))[1:]
    last = 0
    body = b""
    def varlen(v):
        out = bytes([v & 0x7F]); v >>= 7
        while v:
            out = bytes([(v & 0x7F) | 0x80]) + out; v >>= 7
        return out
    for (tt, st, n1, n2) in events:
        body += varlen(tt - last) + bytes([st, n1, n2]); last = tt
    body += b"\x00\xff\x2f\x00"
    track = b"MTrk" + struct.pack(">I", len(body)) + body
    head = b"MThd" + struct.pack(">I", 6) + struct.pack(">HHH", 0, 1, tick)
    open(path, "wb").write(head + track)
    print("wrote", path, "-", len(events) // 2, "notes")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "midi":
        write_midi()
    else:
        print_sheet()
